title: Dead code: _row_to_dict contextmanager defined but never used
evidence: app.py:53-59 defines @contextmanager _row_to_dict; no call site exists (routes use dict(row) directly, e.g. app.py:97,113,123)
suggestion: Remove the unused helper or use it consistently for row conversion

title: init_db() executes at import time as a side effect
evidence: app.py:50 calls init_db() at module top level, creating/opening the DB on import rather than in an app factory or __main__ guard
suggestion: Move schema init into an app factory or guard it; the test suite works around this by re-calling init_db() after swapping DATABASE (test_app.py:25)

title: ?author= filter uses substring LIKE match rather than exact match
evidence: app.py:108 uses author LIKE '%...%'; spec does not specify match semantics, so this is a reasonable interpretation exercised by test_list_books_with_filter (test_app.py:112)
suggestion: None required; note the substring behavior in README if exact match is intended
